import requests, json, re, numpy as np, pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# ---------- A. cross-species conservation: UniRef50 clusters, list organisms ----------
def uniref(acc, ident="0.5"):
    q=f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/search?query=(uniprot_id:{acc})%20AND%20(identity:{ident})&format=json&size=3"
    res=requests.get(q,timeout=90).json().get("results",[])
    if not res: return None,[]
    cid=res[0]["id"]
    mem=requests.get(f"https://rest.uniprot.org/uniref/{cid}/members?format=json&size=400",timeout=150).json().get("results",[])
    return cid,[(m.get("accessions",[None])[0], m.get("organismName",""), m.get("sequence",{}).get("value","")) for m in mem]

cons=[]
for g,a in [("SQT-3","P08124"),("DPY-17","Q20778")]:
    cid,mem=uniref(a)
    cae=[(ac,o,s) for ac,o,s in mem if "Caenorhabditis" in o and s]
    nem=[(ac,o,s) for ac,o,s in mem if s]
    hit=0; lines=[]
    for ac,o,s in cae:
        f=None
        for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',s):
            p1=m.start()+4
            if p1<0.45*len(s): f=(m.group(1),p1,s[p1:p1+5]); break
        if f: hit+=1
        lines.append((ac,o[:40],f))
    print(f"=== {g} {cid}: {len(mem)} members, {len(cae)} Caenorhabditis")
    for l in lines[:20]: print("   ",l)
    cons.append(dict(gene=g,cluster=cid,members=len(mem),caenorhabditis=len(cae),with_RXXR=hit))

# fallback: genus-wide UniProt search for the SQT-3/DPY-17 orthologue motif signature
def gsearch(q,size=200):
    r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
        params={"query":q,"fields":"accession,gene_names,organism_name,sequence","format":"json","size":size},timeout=120)
    return [(e["primaryAccession"],
             ";".join(g.get("geneName",{}).get("value","") for g in e.get("genes",[])),
             e["organism"]["scientificName"], e["sequence"]["value"]) for e in r.json().get("results",[])]

gen = gsearch('(taxonomy_id:6237) NOT (taxonomy_id:6239) AND (protein_name:collagen)')
print("\nNon-elegans Caenorhabditis collagen entries in UniProt: %d"%len(gen))
orgs=pd.Series([o for _,_,o,_ in gen]).value_counts()
print(orgs.head(10).to_string())
ok=0; tot=0
anchors=[]
for ac,gn,o,s in gen:
    if len(s)<200 or len(s)>500: continue
    tot+=1
    f=None
    for m in re.finditer(r'(?=(R..R))',s):
        p1=m.start()+4
        if 30<p1<0.45*len(s): f=(m.group(1),p1,s[p1:p1+4]); break
    if f: ok+=1; anchors.append(f)
print("Caenorhabditis (non-elegans) cuticle-collagen-sized entries with an N-terminal RXXR: %d/%d (%.0f%%)"%(ok,tot,100*ok/max(tot,1)))
print("P1' residue distribution in those orthologues:", pd.Series([a[2][0] for a in anchors]).value_counts().head(6).to_dict())

# ---------- B. benchmark SQT-3 / DPY-17 sites against validated furin substrates ----------
bench = {  # P6..P2' around the validated furin cleavage site
 "hTGFB1 (P01137) RHRR|ALD":"SSRHRRALD",
 "hNotch1 (P46531) RQRR|GGG":"GRRQRRGGG",
 "hProBMP1 ... RSRR|AAT":"QRSRRAAT",
 "Anthrax PA RKKR|STS":"NSRKKRSTS",
 "hFurin propept RTKR|DVY":"RTKRDVY",
 "SQT-3 (P08124) RTTR|QAY":"RNRTTRQAY",
 "DPY-17 (Q20778) RVRR|QAG":"KFGRVRRQAG",
 "DPY-5 (P91285) RHKR|SNS":"IFGRHKRSNS",
}
def pitou_like(ctx, cut):
    """simple interpretable score: basic residues at P1,P2,P4,P6 + P1' penalty"""
    i=ctx.index(cut)+len(cut)  # not used
    return None
rows=[]
for name,ctx in bench.items():
    m=re.search(r'R..R',ctx)
    p1=m.end()  # index after P1 R
    P1,P2,P3,P4=ctx[p1-1],ctx[p1-2],ctx[p1-3],ctx[p1-4]
    P6=ctx[p1-6] if p1>=6 else "-"
    P1p=ctx[p1] if p1<len(ctx) else "-"
    s=0
    s+=2 if P1=="R" else 0
    s+=2 if P2 in "KR" else 0
    s+=1 if P3 in "KR" else 0
    s+=2 if P4=="R" else 0
    s+=1 if P6 in "KR" else 0
    s-=3 if P1p=="P" else 0
    s+=0.5 if P1p in "ASQGN" else 0   # small/polar P1' favoured
    rows.append(dict(substrate=name,P6=P6,P4=P4,P3=P3,P2=P2,P1=P1,P1prime=P1p,score=s))
Bm=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values("score",ascending=False)
print("\n=== Furin-site quality benchmark (interpretable P6-P1' score) ===")
print(Bm.to_string(index=False))
Bm.to_csv("furin_site_benchmark.csv",index=False)

fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(9,4.5))
cols=["#E45756" if ("SQT-3" in s or "DPY-17" in s or "DPY-5" in s) else "#4C78A8" for s in Bm.substrate]
ax.barh(Bm.substrate,Bm.score,color=cols)
ax.set_xlabel("P6-P1' furin-site score (basic-residue weighted)")
ax.set_title("C. elegans cuticle collagen sites scored against validated furin substrates")
ax.invert_yaxis(); plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
